prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” tanning salon for everyone in Columbus — the right place depends on which neighborhood you’re in and whether you want UV tanning (beds) or a spray tan, plus your priorities (price, privacy, cleanliness, boutique experience, membership options). I can recommend specific salons if you tell me your area and which type of tanning you want. Meanwhile, here’s how to find the best one for you and what to look for:

How to pick a great salon
- Decide spray tan vs. UV beds (spray is safer; UV raises skin-cancer risk).  
- Check recent Google and Yelp reviews for cleanliness, staff friendliness, and consistency.  
- Look for up-to-date equipment (high-pressure or stand-up booths, modern beds with higher tanning levels) if you want UV.  
- Ask whether technicians are certified for spray tans and what products/solutions they use (custom mixes, DHA quality).  
- Inspect or ask about sanitation and disinfection procedures.  
- Compare pricing, packages, and cancellation/no-show policies.  
- Ask if they offer consultations and patch tests (important for spray tans and first-time UV users).  
- Verify hours and walk-in availability if you need flexibility.

Where to look
- Google Maps and Yelp (sort by rating + recent reviews)  
- Facebook pages and local neighborhood groups for word-of-mouth recommendations  
- Instagram for before/after photos (especially for spray-tan studios)

Safety note
- If you use UV tanning, follow staff guidance on session length and frequency. Consider sunless spray tans or bronzers as a safer alternative.

If you tell me: (1) spray or UV, and (2) which part of Columbus (e.g., downtown, Short North, Westerville, Easton, Upper Arlington), I’ll give a short list of well-reviewed salons in that area and what to ask each one.
